thread:
support-alyssa: FYI customer reported a regression when using structured output + array mode. Getting 400 parse errors intermittently :confused:
eng-ml-raj: Can you paste the failing payload/response?
support-alyssa: Pasting redacted convo and API logs below. Customer says it started after last week's runtime roll. They see some array items missing required `id` field and some items have extra `debug_meta` keys. Parser chokes.
eng-runtime: ugh. We saw a couple related fixes in the roll. Send the exact request and the bad response body.
support-alyssa: Request (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "mode": "structured_json",
  "schema": {"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["id","value"]}},
  "input": "..."
}
```
Bad response body they got (as returned to user):
```
[{
  "value": "foo",
  "debug_meta": {"shard":3}
},
{
  "id": "b",
  "value": "bar"
},
{
  "value": "baz",
  "tempid": null
}]
```
eng-ml-raj: Looks like partial objects (missing `id`) interleaved with valid ones. Also extra keys like `debug_meta` and `tempid` which the strict schema rejects. Could be streaming/split-item boundary behavior.
eng-runtime: We changed chunking logic to favor lower latency — might have increased chance of emitting partial items at chunk boundary when streaming. But we should never return syntactically invalid/partial objects for `structured_json` mode. That violates the contract.
sre-lina: Any errors in runtime logs? Request IDs?
support-alyssa: Customer provided request_id: req_0a1b2c. Logs attached in support ticket (link). They also reported ~10% failure rate on batches of 50 items, and they retried -> billing increased.
billing-mark: If they retried because of parse errors, we can do a credit for the retry storms. I'll need counts. Can support provide the retry timestamps?
support-alyssa: Sent them to billing. Customer says auth header was fine, no 401s. Only 400s on parse.
eng-ml-raj: Repro attempt: I ran a local harness against the canary runtime with stress: 500 requests, streaming enabled, forced sequence splits. I reproduced partial-object emissions about ~3% of the time. Sample output had trailing commas and truncated JSON in chunk boundaries.
eng-runtime: Confirmed. We introduced a micro-optimization that flushes partially-serialized objects earlier for latency reasons. That was dumb for strict modes.
sre-lina: Mitigation plan: roll back the micro-optimization for structured/strict modes, add a server-side sanity check that discards and retries responses that don't match schema before returning 200 to clients. Also add a gating test in CI.
eng-ml-raj: Agreed. For immediate mitigation we can: 1) add a compatibility fallback that wraps streaming to always buffer and emit only complete items for `mode=structured_json` when schema `items.required` present, 2) return 5xx instead of 200+invalid payload to force safe retries.
support-alyssa: Customer asked for repro steps so they can validate after fix. I'll share your test harness and example curl.
eng-runtime: Action items: revert optimization on canary (PR #3501), deploy hotfix to hosted region eu-west-1, and add schema-validate-before-send path. I'll open the PR and tag @sre-lina.
eng-runtime: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/3501 :deploy: (build passed)
sre-lina: I'll fast-track the canary rollback. Schedule: rollback canary in 30m, monitor for parse errors.
eng-ml-raj: For root cause notes: ordering assumptions by some clients made things worse — one client assumed output array preserved internal source order. When partial objects get dropped by downstream validation, their index-based mapping broke. We should call this out in docs: streaming doesn't guarantee stable indices if items are partial/truncated.
support-alyssa: Customer also flagged that extra keys (e.g., `debug_meta`) are breaking their strict schema validator. They expect we strip internal fields. Can we add an option to sanitize keys?
eng-runtime: We can add an option server-side to remove fields prefixed with `_` or `debug_`, but I don't want that enabled by default. We'll propose `sanitize_fields: ["debug_meta","tempid"]` flag in request config as an opt-in.
billing-mark: For the billing hit: customer retried ~120 requests in last 2h. I'll propose a credit of the extra retries and waive the spike. Need support ticket ID.
support-alyssa: Ticket #SUP-9821 — shared with billing.
eng-ml-raj: Tests to add: fuzz streaming boundary cases, explicit tests for required fields present in all emitted items, and a regression test that fails if any client-visible response violates the provided JSON schema.
eng-runtime: Deploy bot: starting rollback to previous runtime image on canary (eu-west-1) now.
deploy-bot: deploy started for req_0a1b2c -> canary-eu-west-1 (image redwood/runtime:2026-03-10-rc).
sre-lina: Monitoring: I'll watch `structured_json.parse_errors` metric and alert on > 0.5% rate.
support-alyssa: I'll message the customer with repro, ETA for fix (2-4 hours), and offer credit for retries. Thanks everyone.
billing-mark: I'll draft the credit and post here when ready.
eng-ml-raj: Follow-up: we'll add a short doc blurb about streaming semantics and recommended client-level tolerant parsing strategies (e.g., validate per-item by `id` rather than by position).
support-alyssa: Closing loop when rollback and hotfix are live. :thumbsup:
